decision.summary: Two regions stand out: (1) a complex multi-axis offset starting near index 490 within the 485–544 window, featuring non-symmetric shifts and possible superposed motion; (2) a sharp, near-simultaneous large jump across all axes near index 610–615 in the 605–664 window, with clear pre- and post-event plateaus. Both warrant closer inspection for morphology.

regions.observation: Cross-axis shape shows a multi-sample abrupt shift in N/E/U around index 490–495, with large opposing excursions: N drops sharply while E and U rise, then all three components show a sustained offset lasting ~50 samples before gradual relaxation. The change is not symmetric across axes and includes possible superposed smaller fluctuations.

A prominent multi-sample jump occurs near index 610–615: N shifts from ~-7 to ~0, E drops from ~17 to ~1.4, and U falls from ~24.8 to ~3.8 over 3–4 samples. This appears as a near-simultaneous large offset across all axes, possibly a permanent jump or temporary platform; surrounding samples (605–620) show clear pre- and post-jump levels with no immediate return.
